paper_title: The topological susceptibility in finite temperature QCD and axion cosmology
notes: Lattice QCD study of topological susceptibility, constraining the axion decay constant f_a vs oscillation temperature (Fig. 6) for QCD axion dark matter. Main quoted bound: f_a <= 1.2e12 GeV. However, the result is presented as f_a vs T_osc (not m_a), and no tabulated (mass, coupling) data points are available; the constraint is a band in the f_a-T_osc plane. No extractable numerical data points for a coupling-vs-mass plane. | read-vote N=3: ct=AxionMass (3/3); no consensus curve, took most-points
